title: Work & School
description: Talk about what you do all day.

questions.sentence: Tumi ki kaj koro?
options: Ami ekjon sikkhok.
Ami bhaat khai.
Ami bari jai.
questions.correctAnswer: Ami ekjon sikkhok.
questions.translatedSentence: I am a teacher.

questions.sentence: Ami office e kaj kori.
options: I work in an office.
I am going to the office.
I do not work in an office.
questions.correctAnswer: I work in an office.

questions.sentence: Apni kothay kaj koren?
options: Ami ekta baank e kaj kori.
Ami baank e taka rakhi.
Ami ekhon barite achi.
questions.correctAnswer: Ami ekta baank e kaj kori.
questions.translatedSentence: I work at a bank.

questions.sentence: Amar didi ekjon daktar.
options: My elder sister is a doctor.
My elder sister is a teacher.
My elder brother is a doctor.
questions.correctAnswer: My elder sister is a doctor.

questions.sentence: Apnar office kothay?
options: Amar office Salt Lake e.
Amar bari Salt Lake e.
Ami office e jai na.
questions.correctAnswer: Amar office Salt Lake e.
questions.translatedSentence: My office is in Salt Lake.

questions.sentence: Ami ekta skule porai.
options: I teach at a school.
I study at a school.
I am going to a school.
questions.correctAnswer: I teach at a school.

questions.sentence: Tumi kon company te kaj koro?
options: Ami ekta chhoto company te kaj kori.
Amar company ta khub boro.
Ami kal company te jabo.
questions.correctAnswer: Ami ekta chhoto company te kaj kori.
questions.translatedSentence: I work at a small company.

questions.sentence: Amar dada ekjon engineer.
options: My elder brother is an engineer.
My elder brother is a student.
My younger brother is an engineer.
questions.correctAnswer: My elder brother is an engineer.

questions.sentence: Tomar kaj ki bhalo lage?
options: Haan, amar kaj khub bhalo lage.
Na, ami kono kaj kori na.
Amar cha khub bhalo lage.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, amar kaj khub bhalo lage.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I like my work very much.

questions.sentence: Tomar boi ta kothay?
options: Amar boi bag er moddhe ache.
Amar bag klase ache.
Ami ekhon boi porchi.
questions.correctAnswer: Amar boi bag er moddhe ache.
questions.translatedSentence: My book is in my bag.

questions.sentence: Sikkhok board e likhchen.
options: The teacher is writing on the board.
The teacher is reading from the book.
The student is writing on the board.
questions.correctAnswer: The teacher is writing on the board.

questions.sentence: Ei prosno ta ki tumi bujhte parcho?
options: Na, ami bujhte parchi na.
Haan, ami klase achi.
Na, amar kolom nei.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, ami bujhte parchi na.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I do not understand it.

questions.sentence: Amar kachhe kono kolom nei.
options: I do not have a pen.
I have a pen with me.
I do not have a notebook.
questions.correctAnswer: I do not have a pen.

questions.sentence: Ami ki ekhon ekta prosno korte pari?
options: Haan, obossoi korte paro.
Na, ami prosno ta bujhini.
Haan, ami boi ta porechi.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, obossoi korte paro.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, of course you can.

questions.sentence: Amra klase bangla shikhchi.
options: We are learning Bengali in class.
We are teaching Bengali in class.
We learn Bengali at home.
questions.correctAnswer: We are learning Bengali in class.

questions.sentence: Tomar khata ta ke niyeche?
options: Amar bondhu niyeche.
Ami notun khata kini.
Amar khata ta khub boro.
questions.correctAnswer: Amar bondhu niyeche.
questions.translatedSentence: My friend took it.

questions.sentence: Sikkhok amake ekta prosno korlen.
options: The teacher asked me a question.
I asked the teacher a question.
The teacher answered my question.
questions.correctAnswer: The teacher asked me a question.

questions.sentence: Klas koyta theke shuru hoy?
options: Klas noyta theke shuru hoy.
Klas dupure sesh hoy.
Ami noyta y bari jai.
questions.correctAnswer: Klas noyta theke shuru hoy.
questions.translatedSentence: Class starts at nine.

questions.sentence: Meeting ta koyta y shuru hobe?
options: Meeting ta egarota y shuru hobe.
Meeting ta kal sesh hoyeche.
Ami egarota y office e ashi.
questions.correctAnswer: Meeting ta egarota y shuru hobe.
questions.translatedSentence: The meeting will start at eleven.

questions.sentence: Ami tomake email ta pathiye dichhi.
options: I am sending you the email.
I sent you the email yesterday.
I will send you the file tomorrow.
questions.correctAnswer: I am sending you the email.

questions.sentence: Amar desk ta kothay?
options: Tomar desk janalar pashe.
Tomar file table er upore.
Amar desk ta khub porishkar.
questions.correctAnswer: Tomar desk janalar pashe.
questions.translatedSentence: Your desk is next to the window.

questions.sentence: Boss ekhon meeting e achen.
options: The boss is in a meeting right now.
The boss will come to the meeting.
The boss is not in the office today.
questions.correctAnswer: The boss is in a meeting right now.

questions.sentence: Tumi ki file ta pathiyecho?
options: Haan, ami sokale pathiye diyechi.
Haan, ami meeting e chilam.
Na, amar computer ta notun.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, ami sokale pathiye diyechi.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I sent it in the morning.

questions.sentence: Amar computer ta kaj korche na.
options: My computer is not working.
My computer is very old.
My phone is not working.
questions.correctAnswer: My computer is not working.

questions.sentence: Apni ki ekhon ektu kotha bolte parben?
options: Ekhon na, ami meeting e jachhi.
Haan, ami phone ta dhorechi.
Na, amar desk ta khali ache.
questions.correctAnswer: Ekhon na, ami meeting e jachhi.
questions.translatedSentence: Not now, I am going into a meeting.

questions.sentence: Meeting er por ami tomake phone korbo.
options: I will call you after the meeting.
I called you before the meeting.
I will email you after the meeting.
questions.correctAnswer: I will call you after the meeting.

questions.sentence: Aajker meeting ta kemon holo?
options: Bhalo holo, sob thik ache.
Meeting ta agami sombar hobe.
Ami meeting e jete parbo na.
questions.correctAnswer: Bhalo holo, sob thik ache.
questions.translatedSentence: It went well, everything is fine.

questions.sentence: Tomar porikkha kobe?
options: Amar porikkha agami sombar.
Ami porikkha diye esechi.
Porikkha ta khub kothin chilo.
questions.correctAnswer: Amar porikkha agami sombar.
questions.translatedSentence: My exam is next Monday.

questions.sentence: Aaj amake onek porte hobe.
options: I have to study a lot today.
I studied a lot today.
I do not want to study today.
questions.correctAnswer: I have to study a lot today.

questions.sentence: Tomar barir kaj ta ki sesh hoyeche?
options: Na, ekhono sesh hoyni.
Haan, ami barite achi.
Na, ami barir kaj pai ni.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, ekhono sesh hoyni.
questions.translatedSentence: No, it is not finished yet.

questions.sentence: Ei chapter ta amar khub kothin lagche.
options: I am finding this chapter very hard.
This chapter feels very easy to me.
I have already finished this chapter.
questions.correctAnswer: I am finding this chapter very hard.

questions.sentence: Porikkhay kemon korle?
options: Bhalo korechi, sob likhte perechi.
Porikkha ta kal shuru hobe.
Ami porikkhay boshte chai na.
questions.correctAnswer: Bhalo korechi, sob likhte perechi.
questions.translatedSentence: I did well, I could write everything.

questions.sentence: Kal ami onek raat obdi porechi.
options: Last night I studied until very late.
Last night I went to sleep very early.
Tonight I will study until very late.
questions.correctAnswer: Last night I studied until very late.

questions.sentence: Tumi ki amake ektu bujhiye debe?
options: Haan, ami tomake bujhiye debo.
Haan, ami kichhu bujhte parchi na.
Na, ami sikkhok ke prosno korbo.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, ami tomake bujhiye debo.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I will explain it to you.

questions.sentence: Amader sikkhok bolechen porikkha sohoj hobe.
options: Our teacher has said the exam will be easy.
Our teacher has said the exam will be hard.
Our teacher will give us the exam tomorrow.
questions.correctAnswer: Our teacher has said the exam will be easy.

questions.sentence: Tumi ki porikkhar jonno tairi?
options: Haan, ami puropuri tairi.
Na, porikkha ta sesh hoyeche.
Haan, ami porikkha diye esechilam.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, ami puropuri tairi.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I am completely ready.

questions.sentence: Tumi aaj eto deri korle keno?
options: Rastay onek jam chilo.
Ami somoy moto eshe gechi.
Kal ami deri kore berobo.
questions.correctAnswer: Rastay onek jam chilo.
questions.translatedSentence: There was a lot of traffic on the road.

questions.sentence: Aaj ami metro te office eshechi.
options: Today I came to the office by metro.
Today I came to the office late.
Every day I go to the office by tram.
questions.correctAnswer: Today I came to the office by metro.

questions.sentence: Apnar office koyta obdi chole?
options: Amar office chhoyta obdi chole.
Amar office Howrah bridge er kachhe.
Ami chhoyta y bari pouchhai.
questions.correctAnswer: Amar office chhoyta obdi chole.
questions.translatedSentence: My office runs until six.

questions.sentence: Kal ami chhuti nebo, karon amar shorir bhalo nei.
options: I will take leave tomorrow, because I am not well.
I took leave yesterday, because I was not well.
I cannot take leave tomorrow, because there is a meeting.
questions.correctAnswer: I will take leave tomorrow, because I am not well.

questions.sentence: Ami ki aaj ektu tairatari berote pari?
options: Haan, kintu kaj ta sesh kore jeo.
Na, tumi kal deri kore esechile.
Haan, ami kal chhuti nebo.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, kintu kaj ta sesh kore jeo.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, but finish the work before you go.

questions.sentence: Train deri korle ami somoy moto pouchhate pari na.
options: If the train is late, I cannot reach on time.
If the train is late, I take the bus instead.
The train is late, so I will not go today.
questions.correctAnswer: If the train is late, I cannot reach on time.

questions.sentence: Tomar chhuti ta ki manjur hoyeche?
options: Haan, boss manjur kore diyechen.
Na, ami chhuti chai ni.
Haan, ami chhuti te bari chilam.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, boss manjur kore diyechen.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, the boss has approved it.

questions.sentence: Ami sokal noyta r moddhe office e dhuki.
options: I get to the office by nine in the morning.
I leave the office at nine in the morning.
I get to the office by ten every day.
questions.correctAnswer: I get to the office by nine in the morning.

questions.sentence: Tumi roj kibhabe office asho?
options: Ami roj metro te ashi.
Ami roj noyta y ashi.
Ami roj office e kaj kori.
questions.correctAnswer: Ami roj metro te ashi.
questions.translatedSentence: I come by metro every day.

questions.sentence: Agami bochor tomar ki plan?
options: Bhalo sujog pele ami notun kaj khujbo.
Kal ami office e jabo na.
Amar plan ta bhalo chilo na.
questions.correctAnswer: Bhalo sujog pele ami notun kaj khujbo.
questions.translatedSentence: If I get a good opportunity, I will look for a new job.

questions.sentence: Ami onek din dhore ei company te achi, kintu ekhono promotion pai ni.
options: I have been at this company for a long time, but I still have not got a promotion.
I have been at this company for a long time, and last year I got a promotion.
I joined this company recently, so I have not got a promotion yet.
questions.correctAnswer: I have been at this company for a long time, but I still have not got a promotion.

questions.sentence: Tumi ki promotion niye kotha bolecho?
options: Haan, ami boss er songe kotha bolechi.
Na, ami promotion peye gechi.
Haan, ami kal chhuti nebo.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, ami boss er songe kotha bolechi.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I have spoken to my boss about it.

questions.sentence: Jodi ami bhalo kaj kori, tahole amar maine barbe.
options: If I do good work, my salary will go up.
If I do good work, I will get a promotion.
My salary went up because I did good work.
questions.correctAnswer: If I do good work, my salary will go up.

questions.sentence: Apni ki bidesh e porte jete chan?
options: Haan, ami agami bochor jete chai.
Na, ami bidesh theke phire esechi.
Haan, ami bidesh e porechilam.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, ami agami bochor jete chai.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I want to go next year.

questions.sentence: Amar ichhe ekdin nijer ekta chhoto company kholar.
options: My wish is to open my own small company one day.
My wish is to work in a big company one day.
One day I will have to close my small company.
questions.correctAnswer: My wish is to open my own small company one day.

questions.sentence: Notun kaj ta niye tumi ki bhabcho?
options: Kaj ta bhalo, kintu maine ektu kom.
Ami kaj ta ekhono shuru kori ni.
Notun kaj ta kal sesh hoye gechhe.
questions.correctAnswer: Kaj ta bhalo, kintu maine ektu kom.
questions.translatedSentence: The work is good, but the pay is a little low.

questions.sentence: Ami ar deri korte chai na, karon amar hate besi somoy nei.
options: I do not want to wait any longer, because I do not have much time left.
I do not want to be late, because the meeting has already started.
I have plenty of time left, so I am not in any hurry.
questions.correctAnswer: I do not want to wait any longer, because I do not have much time left.

questions.sentence: Apni agami bochor kothay thakben?
options: Ami sombhoboto Kolkatatei thakbo, karon amar kaj ekhanei.
Ami onek bochor age Kolkata theke esechilam.
Ami agami bochor lomba chhuti nebo.
questions.correctAnswer: Ami sombhoboto Kolkatatei thakbo, karon amar kaj ekhanei.
questions.translatedSentence: I will probably stay in Kolkata itself, because my work is here.
